reader.zh-Hant:
這個模組是 Agent 的組裝入口，現在支援工具白名單、workspace scope、readonly sub-agent 設定、session 壓縮設定與 history memory 壓縮設定。

建議所有整合都透過 `create_agent_components()`，這樣 CLI / Web 的行為會一致。
reader.en: This is the composition root for the agent stack. It now supports tool whitelisting, workspace scoping, readonly sub-agent settings, session compression settings, and history memory compression settings.
reader.ja: エージェント構成の入口モジュールです。ツールホワイトリスト、workspace scope、readonly sub-agent 設定、session 圧縮設定、history memory 圧縮設定に対応しました。

behavior: Builds tool factories for scan/material/workspace/web/subagent tools, including web_topology_spider, dom_skeleton_xray, scrape_page_dom, http_request, and summarize_url_with_secondary_llm.
Registers video orchestration tools: manage_todo_list, list_video_templates, read_video_template, find_images, analyze_image, screenshot_and_review_html.
Registers html_worker_subagent with a dedicated worker tool map (write_workspace_file, read_worker_scoped_file, list/read video template tools).
Respects enabled_tools whitelist when registering tools.
Allows toggling web_search registration via enable_web_search_tool.
AgentRuntime injects _conversation_id and _storage_directory into tool calls for tools that need host context (for example manage_todo_list).

examples.title: Create runtime with scope and tool whitelist

runtime_notes.content: enabled_tools filters which tools are registered to the main runtime.
workspace_scope limits scan/read/summarize workspace tools to a subtree (for example ./materials).

web_topology_spider, dom_skeleton_xray, scrape_page_dom, http_request, and summarize_url_with_secondary_llm are available in tool_factories and can be enabled for both main runtime and readonly sub-agent.
html_worker_subagent uses worker_tool_factories separate from the host map; child tools cannot recurse into html_worker_subagent or readonly_subagent.
manage_todo_list persists JSON under <storage_directory>/todos/<conversation_id>.json; Web UI can poll GET /api/conversations/<id>/todos or listen for SSE todo_updated.
analyze_image uses LMWrapper.analyze_image_bytes (Gemini inlineData or OpenAI-compatible vision). screenshot_and_review_html requires playwright installed and browsers present (see requirements.txt).
